en.title: Only 5 Sith Lords Surpass Darth Maul's Power
en.summary: Darth Maul is a fan-favorite Sith, but how does his raw power stack up against the galaxy's other dark side users? This list breaks down the five Sith Lords who wield even greater might.
en.body:
## 1. Darth Tyranus (Count Dooku)
While initially a respected Jedi Master, Count Dooku's fall to the dark side as Darth Tyranus saw him embrace a more ruthless, calculating form of power. His mastery of lightsaber combat, particularly with his elegant curved hilt, and his potent Force abilities made him a formidable opponent, serving as Palpatine's apprentice during the Clone Wars.

## 2. Darth Plagueis
Known primarily through Palpatine's tales in *Revenge of the Sith* (2005), Darth Plagueis was a Muun Sith Lord of immense power, obsessed with manipulating the Force to cheat death and create life. His ultimate downfall came at the hands of his own apprentice, highlighting the inherent treachery within Sith ranks.

## 3. Darth Maul
Ray Park's electrifying performance in *The Phantom Menace* (1999) cemented Darth Maul as a visually striking and terrifying Sith. Despite his early defeat, Maul's resilience and mastery of his double-bladed lightsaber, coupled with his raw aggression, made him a persistent threat across multiple Star Wars eras and media, including the *Clone Wars* animated series.

## 4. Darth Sidious (Sheev Palpatine)
As the ultimate architect of the Republic's fall and the Galactic Empire's rise, Darth Sidious, also known as Chancellor Palpatine, is arguably the most cunning and powerful Sith Lord. His mastery over the Force, particularly his potent Force lightning and manipulative genius, allowed him to orchestrate galactic conflict for decades, as seen throughout the Skywalker Saga.

## 5. Darth Vader
Anakin Skywalker's transformation into Darth Vader created a being of immense power, fueled by rage and regret. Even in his cybernetic suit, Vader's connection to the dark side allowed him to crush his enemies with telekinetic might and wield his lightsaber with brutal efficiency, making him a relentless hunter of Jedi survivors after Order 66.

## 6. Darth Vader
Anakin Skywalker's transformation into Darth Vader created a being of immense power, fueled by rage and regret. Even in his cybernetic suit, Vader's connection to the dark side allowed him to crush his enemies with telekinetic might and wield his lightsaber with brutal efficiency, making him a relentless hunter of Jedi survivors after Order 66.

## 7. Darth Vader
Anakin Skywalker's transformation into Darth Vader created a being of immense power, fueled by rage and regret. Even in his cybernetic suit, Vader's connection to the dark side allowed him to crush his enemies with telekinetic might and wield his lightsaber with brutal efficiency, making him a relentless hunter of Jedi survivors after Order 66.

Bottom Line: While Darth Maul is a formidable warrior, the raw power and influence of these five Sith Lords place them in a higher tier of dark side mastery.

tr.title: Sadece 5 Sith Lordu Darth Maul'un Gücünü Aştı
tr.summary: Darth Maul, fanlar tarafından sevilen bir Sith, ancak galaksinin diğer kara taraf kullanıcıları ile raw güç nasıl karşılaştırılır? Bu liste, güçleri daha büyük olan beş Sith Lordu'nu açıklar.
tr.body:
## 1. Darth Tyranus (Count Dooku)
Darth Tyranus, ilk olarak saygı duyulan bir Jedi Ustası olarak görülmüş, ancak Count Dooku'nun Sith tarafa düşüşü, daha cruel ve hesaplı bir güç türü olarak görülmüştür. Elekant bir eğrilikli kılıcı ve güçlü Kuvvet yetenekleri ile lightsaber muharebesinde ustalaşmış, Palpatine'nin klon savaşı sırasında yardımcısı olmuştur.

## 2. Darth Plagueis
*Revenge of the Sith*'te (2005) Palpatine'in hikayeleri aracılığıyla tanınan Darth Plagueis, Muun Sith Lordu'ndan biridir. Kuvveti ile ölümün manipülasyonu ve yaşamın yaratılmasıyla ilgilendi, ancak sonunu kendi öğrencisi tarafından geldi, Sith sıralarındaki içsel hırsızlıkla ilgili olduğunu gösterdi.

## 3. Darth Maul
*The Phantom Menace*'in (1999) Ray Park'ın etkileyici performansı, Darth Maul'u görüntülü bir ve korkutucu Sith olarak yerleştirir. İlk yenilgisinden sonra bile, Maul'un direnci ve çift-bladed lightsaberinin ustalığı, kaba agresyonuyla birlikte, birçok Star Wars çağı ve medyasında, *Clone Wars*' animasyon dizisinde de devam etti.

## 4. Darth Sidious (Sheev Palpatine)
Galaktik İmparatorluğun yükselişini ve Cumhuriyet'in düşüşünü planlayan Darth Sidious, Chancellor Palpatine olarak da bilinen, en akıllı ve güçlü Sith Lordu'dur. Kuvveti, özellikle güçlü Kuvvet fırtınası ve manipülatif geni ile, galaksinin savaşı için decades boyunca planlamış, Skywalker Serüveni'nde görülmüştür.

## 5. Darth Vader
Anakin Skywalker'in Darth Vader'e dönüşü, bir güç yarattı. Öfke ve pişmanlık tarafından ateşlenen Vader, cybernetik giysisinden bile, telekinetik güçle düşmanlarını ezerek ve lightsaberini brutal verimlilikle kullandı, bu sayede Jedi hayatta kalanları aramaya devam etti.

es.title: Solo 5 Señores Sith Superan el Poder de Darth Maul
es.summary: Darth Maul es un fan-favorito Sith, pero ¿cómo se compara su poder bruto con los usuarios de la fuerza oscura del resto del universo? Esta lista analiza a los cinco Señores Sith que poseen una mayor capacidad.
es.body:
## 1. Darth Tyranus (Conde Dooku)

Mientras inicialmente era un respetado Maestro Jedi, la caída de Conde Dooku al lado oscuro como Darth Tyranus lo llevó a abrazar una forma de poder más cruel y calculadora. Su dominio del combate con espadas luminosas, particularmente con su elegante hilt curvo, y sus potentes habilidades de la fuerza lo convirtieron en un oponente formidable, sirviendo como aprendiz de Palpatine durante las Guerras Clon.

## 2. Darth Plagueis

Conocido principalmente a través de las historias de Palpatine en *La Venganza de los Sith* (2005), Darth Plagueis fue un Señor Sith Muun de inmenso poder, obsesionado con manipular la fuerza para engañar a la muerte y crear vida. Su caída final vino a manos de su propio aprendiz, destacando la traición inherente dentro de los rangos Sith.

## 3. Darth Maul

La interpretación electrizante de Ray Park en *La Amenaza Fantasma* (1999) consolidó a Darth Maul como un Señor Sith visualmente impactante y aterrador. A pesar de su derrota temprana, la resiliencia y la maestría de Maul con su espada doble blanca, unidas a su agresividad bruta, lo convirtieron en un amenaza persistente a lo largo de múltiples eras y medios de Star Wars, incluyendo la serie animada *Guerras Clon*.

## 4. Darth Sidious (Sheev Palpatine)

Como el arquitecto final de la caída de la República y el surgimiento del Imperio Galáctico, Darth Sidious, también conocido como el Canciller Palpatine, es posiblemente el Señor Sith más astuto y poderoso. Su dominio sobre la fuerza, particularmente su potente rayo de fuerza y su genio manipulador, permitió que orquestara conflicto galáctico durante décadas, como se muestra a lo largo de la Saga Skywalker.

## 5. Darth Vader

La transformación de Anakin Skywalker en Darth Vader creó una entidad de inmenso poder, impulsada por ira y arrepentimiento. Incluso en su traje cibernético, la conexión de Vader al lado oscuro le permitió aplastar a sus enemigos con poder telequinésico y manejar su espada con eficiencia brutal, convirtiéndolo en un caza implacable de supervivientes Jedi después de la Orden 66.

## 6. Darth Vader

La transformación de Anakin Skywalker en Darth Vader creó una entidad de inmenso poder, impulsada por ira y arrepentimiento. Incluso en su traje cibernético, la conexión de Vader al lado oscuro le permitió aplastar a sus enemigos con poder telequinésico y manejar su espada con eficiencia brutal, convirtiéndolo en un caza implacable de supervivientes Jedi después de la Orden 66.

## 7. Darth Vader

La transformación de Anakin Skywalker en Darth Vader creó una entidad de inmenso poder, impulsada por ira y arrepentimiento. Incluso en su traje cibernético, la conexión de Vader al lado oscuro le permitió aplastar a sus enemigos con poder telequinésico y manejar su espada con eficiencia brutal, convirtiéndolo en un caza implacable de supervivientes Jedi después de la Orden 66.

En resumen: si bien Darth Maul es un guerrero formidable, el poder bruto e influencia de estos cinco Señores Sith los colocan en un nivel superior de maestría en el lado oscuro.

content_raw: In a galaxy far, far away, the universe that George Lucas first created continues to expand with richer mythology and lore, as fans can never get enough of the epic nature of Star Wars . Originally just three groundbreaking films, the franchise has grown to include multiple movies, video games, books, action figures, and even an immersive land in Disney. A major factor in its ever-growing success is the characters. Today, we're going to focus, though, on the dark side. In the Star Wars franchise, the title of power given to Sith Lords is Darth , which roughly translates to "Dark Lord." The moniker signifies a complete transformation, the elimination of identity to fully commit to the dark side.
